title: Maintenance
description: Default settings for per-page maintenance mode. Individual pages can override these in their Page Data JSON.

heading.label: Heading
heading.help: The page heading (shown as the <h1>) on the maintenance page.

message.label: Default Message
message.help: Shown to visitors when a page is in maintenance mode. Markdown is supported (links, emphasis). Pages can override this in their Page Data.

retryAfter.label: Default Retry-After (seconds)
retryAfter.help: Value for the Retry-After response header. Tells crawlers and clients how long to wait before retrying.

template.label: Custom Template
template.help: Optional Site Builder page template (from tcms-data/builder/pages/) used to render the maintenance page. Leave blank to use the built-in layout. The template receives heading, message (rendered HTML — use {{ message|raw }}), messageText, and retryAfter.
